svg.aria-label: The notebook's code for the four blocks, with handwritten notes. for block in self.blocks: four blocks, one after another, each with its own weights. x = block(x): x is the hidden states, one per letter of the text, rewritten by every block. Inside TransformerBlock.forward, one whole block is two lines. x = x + self.attn(self.ln1(x)): normalise, then attention, which looks back at earlier letters. x = x + self.mlp(self.ln2(x)): normalise, then the MLP, which works on each hidden state on its own. The x plus adds each result, and never replaces what was there.
svg.text: The four blocks, in the notebook's Python
From MiniGPT.forward and TransformerBlock.forward (cells 1.5 and 1.4); the handwritten notes are my own reading
